decision: Replace Leaflet with MapLibre for continuous desktop zoom and pan while retaining the current map interface and OpenStreetMap raster basemap. Cartography and route interaction redesign remain separate work.
implementation: One map instance with two GeoJSON overlay sources; prepared section IDs are promoted for selection state.
Update region feature state and existing marker selection styles without rebuilding their geometry or markers.
Reuse deterministic clustering of all saved result locations in world coordinates, redrawing clusters at zoom end rather than on every animation frame or pan.
Lazy-load the map module and its CSS; use Vite's bundled worker URL without checked-in worker assets or synchronization scripts.
Preserve region locking, coincident-start chooser, hover/focus previews, route selection, saved-job geometry, GPX controls, resize handling and reduced-motion-aware camera transitions.

maintainedSource.method: scripts/source-size.mjs; normal readable formatting; app plus preparation and tooling

javascriptGzipBytes.method: Node gzipSync of emitted production JavaScript, same default settings before and after. These are compressed-size estimates, not network transfer or interaction timing measurements.

verification.build: passed; upstream map chunk exceeds Vite's 500 kB warning threshold and remains separate from the app entry
verification.offlineChecks: 75 Vitest and four Node checks pass. Four localhost fixture checks initially failed because the sandbox denied listeners; only those checks were rerun with localhost permission.
browser: Real saved hike geometry, route details, GPX control and full-height map render; no browser errors.
All 46 saved hike locations retained; panning moves markers without changing cluster membership.
Independent committed network fixture: all three hikes at a coincident start are offered and chooser selection draws the selected route and highlights its marker.
Switching from a saved job to the current two-section catalog updates polygon geometry without recreating the map.
Prepared string-ID polygons toggle the corresponding checkboxes and display selected shading; installed regions have solid borders and undownloaded regions have dashed borders.
Zooming and panning preserve the selected prepared region; no browser errors.
verification.limitation: No claim of measured frame-rate or improvement in raster label quality. The existing live server serves the new client build without restart or interruption of jobs.

basemapIntegration.rationale: Use a ready-made vector hiking basemap with contours and terrain shading, without an account, API key, extra SDK or tile-preparation subsystem.
implementation: Load the provider style once; add the existing two GeoJSON sources and four app overlay layers after style.load.
Keep the provider logo at 24px height and copyright permanently expanded; move the map caption above attribution.
Report a failed style request in the map panel.

comparison.hiking: Marked hiking-route layers and shields, darker paths, narrower roads, rock texture and four hillshade passes.
comparison.summer: Same main OSM and contour tile services, calmer presentation and one gentle hillshade pass.

browser: Real north-region saved job retains all 46 hike locations; Iron Peak / Fourth Creek geometry and GPX link render over contours and trail labels.
The prepared polygon toggles its matching checkbox; panning and zooming preserve its selected state.
Provider logo loads at 24px height; both attribution links remain expanded during pan and zoom.
No browser errors or warnings during these checks.
verification.limitation: Basemap appearance and flows verified in the browser; no new frame-rate, GPU-memory or remote-service availability measurement. Route discovery is unchanged.

labelTypography.implementation: Override the label font expressions once after the provider style loads, matching the preset's weights and retaining non-Latin fallbacks; continue using the provider's existing glyph endpoint.

verification.referenceComparison: All 41 label font expressions match the independent style copied from MapMaker with Hiking and Blured selected.
verification.browser: Saved Iron Peak / Fourth Creek hike renders with the new labels, contours, route geometry and attribution; no browser errors or warnings.
